feedTitle: Shipping forecast for the North Irish Sea

items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 23 May 2026 4:09am
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Saturday, 23 May 2026 at 4:10am by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Nil.


##Synopsis##

High pressure over Central Europe. Low in the mid-Atlantic. New high expected near Cornwall later today, 1031hPa.


##Wind##

Southwest 3 or 4, backing south or south-southwest this afternoon, occasionally increasing 5 in the North Channel and then in central parts of the area later today and early tonight.


##State of Sea##

Mostly slight, but occasionally moderate in central parts of the area later today & tonight.


##Weather##

Mainly fair, but still a few areas of mist near some coasts with a risk of fog patches.


##Visibility##

Moderate or good, occasionally poor in mist, very poor in any fog patches.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

South or south-southwest mainly 3 or 4, but occasionally 5 in the North Channel, becoming variable 3 or less later.


##State of Sea##

Mostly slight, becoming smooth or slight later.


##Weather##

Mainly fair, but a risk of mist or fog patches in places.


##Visibility##

Moderate or good, becoming poor in any mist & very poor in any fog patches.
